Count links between consecutive columns for a Sankey chart

Source: R/helpers.R
data_to_sankey.Rd

Count links between consecutive columns for a Sankey chart

Usage

data_to_sankey(data = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one column per stage, in traversal order. Numeric columns with more than ten distinct finite values are grouped by quintiles. Tied cut points produce fewer groups.

Value

A tibble with from, to, weight (number of transitions) and a unique link id. Links with a missing endpoint are omitted. Fewer than two columns produce an empty tibble with the same columns.

Examples

stages <- dplyr::select(ggplot2::diamonds, cut, color, clarity)
links <- data_to_sankey(stages)
head(links)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 4
#>   from  to    weight id   
#>   <chr> <chr>  <int> <chr>
#> 1 Fair  D        163 FairD
#> 2 Fair  E        224 FairE
#> 3 Fair  F        312 FairF
#> 4 Fair  G        314 FairG
#> 5 Fair  H        303 FairH
#> 6 Fair  I        175 FairI

hchart(links, "sankey", name = "Diamonds")
